video.topic: Tagging my headshots into an AI-readable picker
video.working_title: I Turned My Headshots Into an AI Picker
video.audience: Creators who use their own face in thumbnails
video.promise: Your headshots become a library you and your AI can pick from by expression, gaze and framing

creative.story: AI reads one face and labels it
creative.visual_metaphor: Computer vision made visible, a face as data
creative.style: Editorial photography with clean technical annotation

presenter.gesture_status: Exists in the library as-is; composite the original cutout, do not regenerate the face
presenter.lighting: Soft frontal portrait light with restrained warm rim

composition.background: Cream canvas with a faint light checkerboard patch behind the presenter

secondary_region.content: Thin yellow corner-bracket box around the face

supporting_region.content: Three stacked callout chips joined to the face by thin amber leader lines

graphics: Brown chips with cream monospace text (Roboto Mono)

quality_checks: Presenter identity preserved (original cutout, not a regenerated face)
Light-mode compliance: cream canvas, dark areas contained and under 25%
Headline composited afterwards, spelled correctly, legible at 320x180
Headline does not cover the hero face
No invented UI: any picker imagery is the supplied screenshot or clearly illustrative
Callout values are real manifest values for c30
